options.title: Enable AWS managed PHP + Known Bad Inputs rule groups on the ALB web ACL

add_managed_rule_groups.name: AWSManagedRulesPHPRuleSet
add_managed_rule_groups.reason: AWS PHP rule group (default version includes PHP2Shell signatures)

options.rationale: Blocks published exploit request patterns at the edge before PHP parses the request; no app change.
options.residual_risk: Signature-based; novel exploit variants may bypass. PHP runtime remains vulnerable.
options.rollback: Revert the PR or set mode to count.
